newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Commercial Bank cuts rights price.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Bank cuts rights price.

text.p: Commercial Bank of Ceylon Ltd has revised downwards the price of its rights issue announced in June, stock exchange officials said on Tuesday.
"They are revising the price downwards to 80 rupees a voting share and 70 rupees a non-voting share, because the market price is almost at the rights price," said one official.
The bank had announced a one-for-four rights issue at 100 rupees a voting share and 85 rupees a non-voting share.
The shares were quoted at 90 rupees for a voting share and 84 for a non-voting share on Tuesday against 147 rupees and 123 rupees respectively on June 10.
Analysts said the bank's share price drop was in line with the fall in the all share index, which fell to 563.19 at mid-morning break on Tuesday from 632.31 on June 10.
"There is no rule, but the norm is that rights are usually priced at about a 25 percent discount to the market price," said the official.
Date of allotment of the rights is September 19.
